{% liquid
  assign heading = section.settings.title
  render 'card', title: heading
  include "price"
  section 'hero'
  sections 'header-group'
  capture title-text
  endcapture
  # render 'not-code'
  echo 'render "not-a-tag"'
%}

{% liquid
  comment
  render 'hidden'
  assign hidden = 1
  endcomment
  raw
  capture hidden
  section 'hidden'
  endraw
  render 'visible'
%}
{"comment":"/* not a comment */ // still text", "sections": {"main": {"type": "hero"}}} // allowed

<mapper namespace='com.example.Mapper'>
  <sql id="columns">id, name</sql>
  <select id='find' resultType='User' parameterType="int">SELECT <include refid='columns'/> FROM t</select>
  <update id="touch" parameterType='User'>UPDATE t SET x=1</update>
  <delete id='remove'>DELETE FROM t</delete>
</mapper>

<mapper namespace="com.example.Mapper"><select id="find" databaseId="oracle">SELECT 1 FROM dual</select><select id="find" databaseId='mysql'>SELECT 1</select><select id="find">SELECT 2</select></mapper>
<mapper namespace="com.example.Mapper"><sql id="base">id</sql><select id="all">SELECT <include refid="com.example.Mapper.base"/> FROM t <include refid="external.other.columns"/></select></mapper>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<sqlMap namespace="Account">
<sql id="columns">id, name</sql>
<select id="getById" resultClass="Account">SELECT <include refid="columns"/> FROM account</select>
<insert id="insert" parameterClass="Account">INSERT INTO account VALUES (#id#)</insert>
<statement id="runIt">SELECT 1</statement>
<procedure id="callIt">{ call do_it() }</procedure>
</sqlMap>
